name: GKE Agentic Migration - Developer Workload DAG
description: Per-component developer graph. v0.3 adds the execution slice — STATE_WKLD_TRANSLATE -> REVIEW -> VALIDATE -> APPROVED (HITL ship gate) -> SUBMIT_PR -> DONE, the ladder's FIRST TERMINAL — and retires STATE_WKLD_AWAIT_PIPELINE (v0.2 copies parked there map to STATE_WKLD_TRANSLATE via STATE_MAPPINGS at re-join; server/workload_join.py, DESIGN 6.3). STATE_WKLD_REVIEW also declares on_replan -> STATE_WKLD_PLAN: the plan's exports_stamp is the operand of reuse conjunct (d) and of every unit blob's stamp, and only plan_workload_translation can rebuild it, so without this edge an exports.json bump after planning would be unclearable (retranslating re-writes the same stale stamp and validate keeps refusing). STATE_WKLD_VALIDATE declares BOTH edges (on_success -> APPROVED, on_failure -> REVIEW); STATE_WKLD_SUBMIT_PR's on_failure returns to APPROVED — a DELIBERATE divergence from the platform graph, where a PR failure re-validates: a workload PR failure invalidates nothing the manifest gates checked, so the retry re-raises the ship approval directly. v0.4 makes the wkld-routing family live (HTTPRoutes whose parentRefs come verbatim from exports.gateway) and adds the graph's first GUARDED mapping: STATE_WKLD_DONE -> STATE_WKLD_TRANSLATE when has_unparkable_units — the component has parked units AND exports.gateway now carries a complete name/namespace. Unlike the v0.2 -> v0.3 mappings, a guarded entry is a STANDING re-entry rule, not a one-shot version upgrade: it is re-evaluated on every join at the bundled version, so a component that reached DONE before the platform Gateway published re-enters when it publishes. Re-entry only unparks routing; if anything outside exports.gateway also moved, translate refuses the unpark and sends the component down the on_replan edge instead (server/workload_join.py, DESIGN 6.3).

STATE_WKLD_SCOPE_CONFIRM.prompt_template: Component '{component}': approve the proposed file scope? The proposal, counts and any cluster-scoped-kind warnings are in the tool output above. Rejecting returns to scope selection.

STATE_WKLD_PLAN_REVIEW.prompt_template: Component '{component}': approve the workload translation plan? The unit/family/status summary (including parked and placeholder units) is in the tool output above. Rejecting returns to planning.

STATE_WKLD_APPROVED.prompt_template: Component '{component}': ship the validated Kubernetes manifests as a Pull Request? The unit summary, tradeoffs, parked units and open questions are in the tool output above; the validation report and before/after comparisons are in the ledger under workloads/{component}/. Approving opens the per-component PR branch; declining returns to the unit review.
